text:
Full page.

I ran both shapes. Modal keeps the world visible but shrinks the settings into a drawer you have to scroll inside, and any change that needs a live look — audio mix, FOV, control bindings — makes you close and reopen twice before it lands. On the third try I was fighting the container instead of the slider.

Full page gives the loop somewhere to breathe: one screen, tabs for input/audio/video, and a "back" that returns you exactly where the world paused. The trade is a hard cut on opening, but settings is a place you visit, not a thing you peek at. The player learns the full page once and never navigates it again; the modal teaches itself every time.
